text:
marco: kicking off LON6 bring-up final smoke run. goal: confirm NIC MTU + egress path, GPU driver parity, storage throughput, and SLO gate for p95 tail latency. posting checklist and quick run results.

marco: Quick status: racks r1-r3 powered and cabled, BMCs reachable, but netops flagged an MTU mismatch on spine-2 during initial ARP flood test. @lina can you confirm? :eyes: 

lina: saw the alert. spine-2 had MTU 1500 while TORs were 9000. I pushed a temp fix to re-sync MTU on the TORs to 1500 to stop flapping. filing a follow-up to normalize to 9000 after we validate jumbo frames with model transfers.

dina: note for the checklist: jumbo frames are important for RDMA/GPUDirect tests and for bulk model pulls. for initial smoke keep things conservative (1500) so we don't mask any path MTU issues.

ajay: running the node-level preflight now: kernel and driver versions check, nvlink selftest, and small model load. command I ran: ```ssh root@r1n2 'uname -a && nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,gpu_name,pstate --format=csv'``` output: ```Linux lon6-node-12 5.15.0-88-generic #90-Ubuntu SMP x86_64 GNU/Linux
driverversion, name, pstate
535.86, A100-SXM4-80GB, P0``` all good on that box.

marco: thanks. please paste any failing nodes. also run `sudo cat /proc/net/igmp_max_memberships` to check kernel multicast knobs for service discovery.

ajay: ran micro-bench for model startup and KV cache warmup: ```./benchgen --model /mnt/models/7b-q4_0 --seq 512 --threads 4 --tokens 1024``` result: cold load 260ms, steady p50 20ms, p95 118ms. p95 is just under our gate (120ms) on r1 rack. attaching logs snippet: ```[INFO] model load complete in 260ms
[INFO] generation p95=118.3ms tokens=1024```.

dina: run the same bench against a different rack (r3) and the dedicated local cache (s3 NFS fallback) to ensure no outliers from storage. also confirm parallel launches to catch contention.

lina: sanity RDMA check between two GPUs: ```ibv_devinfo``` shows active on hca0, and `ib_write_bw -d mlx5_0` gives ~90GB/s which is expected for SXM A100 interconnect.

marco: network egress validation: verify NAT egress throughput and source IP stability. small script: ```curl -s https://ifconfig.co/json | jq .ip``` run from a few pods behind the NAT gateway. results: some returned expected egress IP, one returned a different IP (possible multiple NAT gateways without symmetric routing). @ops-bot any scheduled egress switchover?

ops-bot: Automated note: egress-scaler job executed at 2244999900 — scaled gateway pool from 2->4. No planned reroutes. Please file if asymmetric egress observed.

ajay: filed #infra-2245 with traceroutes and tcpdumps. early hypothesis: asymmetric return path via internet-facing load-balancer due to ECMP on provider. recommended temp fix: pin source IP using SNAT pool for the cluster during compliance-sensitive tests.

dina: cost gate check: bringing these racks up in reserved vs burst mode — we will exceed forecasted monthly GPU hours if left in burst for >72h. ops: plan to set autoscale cap to 220 GPUs after handoff, not 320. confirm with finance before long-run tests.

marco: agreed. I'll toggle capacity to reserve mode after we hit the SLO gate and sanity tests.

lina: final pre-handoff checklist (short):
- PDU and inlet current verified (per-rack) :white_check_mark:
- GPU driver and kernel parity across racks :white_check_mark:
- NVLink / RDMA bandwidth passing :white_check_mark:
- Storage read throughput >= 5GB/s per node for model artifacts :white_check_mark:
- MTU consistent or documented fallback path :warning: (spine-2 still needs jumbo restoration)
- Egress stable (SNAT pinned for compliance tests) :white_check_mark:
- Canary model p95 < 120ms for 512 seq across 95% nodes :white_check_mark:

marco: I'll schedule the readiness review at 2245000600 if we fix the spine MTU and confirm storage runs on r3. handoff checklist also needs the runbook link and runbook owner assigned. runbook: https://wiki.redwood/infra/lon6-bringup-runbook

ajay: r3 storage bench: ```dd if=/mnt/models/testfile of=/dev/null bs=1M count=6000``` throughput steady ~5.3GB/s. posting raw output in #infra-2245.

marco: excellent. once MTU normalized to 9000 and validated with a 1GB model transfer (rsync) and jumbo test, we'll flip to reserved capacity and start the 24h soak with telemetry enabled.

lina: creating the MTU normalization ticket now and tagging netops and oncall. after that I will run the jumbo-frame validation script: ```./validate-jumbo.sh --targets r1,r2,r3 --size 4m --iterations 10```

dina: small note for the formal readiness review: bring the following artifacts: node health CSV, benchgen outputs, `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` snapshots, `dmesg` greps for ECC errors, and the cost forecast for 30/90 days.

marco: perfect. if everything passes by 2245000300 we'll proceed with handoff. thanks team. :rocket:
